title: Why Are LLMs Confidently Wrong? Correcting Overconfident Errors via Causal Head Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.34994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) often exhibit overconfident errors, assigning high confidence to incorrect predictions and thereby undermining reliability in real-world use. Existing calibration methods typically rely on post-hoc adjustment or retraining, operating at the output level without addressing the underlying causes of miscalibration. We propose CoCHI, (Class-oriented Causal Head Intervention), a framework that improves calibration by identifying and intervening on internal components responsible for distinct confidence behaviours. By analysing predictions through correctness-confidence patterns, CoCHI enables targeted intervention on model internals, reducing overconfident errors while preserving correct predictions. Our approach provides a mechanistic perspective on calibration, linking reliability to identifiable structures within the model rather than treating it as an output-level issue. Experiments across multiple LLMs

translated_title: 为什么大语言模型会自信地犯错？通过因果注意力头干预纠正过度自信错误
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）常常表现出过度自信的错误，对不正确的预测赋予很高的置信度，从而削弱了其在实际应用中的可靠性。现有的校准方法通常依赖于事后调整或重新训练，仅在输出层面进行操作，而未能解决错误校准的根本原因。我们提出了CoCHI（面向类别的因果注意力头干预），这是一个通过识别并干预负责不同置信行为的内部组件来改善校准的框架。通过从正确性-置信度模式的角度分析预测，CoCHI能够对模型内部进行有针对性的干预，在减少过度自信错误的同时保留正确的预测。我们的方法从机制角度审视校准问题，将可靠性归因于模型中可识别的内部结构，而不是将其视为输出层面的问题。在多个大语言模型上的实验……
tldr: 提出CoCHI框架，通过识别并干预导致过度自信错误的模型内部因果注意力头，从机制层面改善大语言模型的校准，在保留正确预测的同时减少过度自信错误。
en_tdlr: CoCHI identifies and intervenes on internal causal heads responsible for overconfident errors, improving LLM calibration at the mechanistic level while preserving correct predictions.
